title: Don’t Forget the Vine When You See the Fruit
headline: Why Success Can Be a Spiritual Test
headline_sub: Don’t Forget the Vine When You See the Fruit
tagline: Don’t let visible fruit make you forget invisible supply.
seo_title: Why Success Is a Spiritual Test: Deuteronomy 8:17-18 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: There is a battle after the breakthrough. A devotional for men on Deuteronomy 8, pride and success: don't forget the Vine when you see the fruit.
verse_text: You may say to yourself, “My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me.” But remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth….

scriptures.text: You may say to yourself, “My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me.” But remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth….
What do you have that you did not receive?
The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.

items: There is a moment when you desperately need to return to Christ, and it may be the moment you are least likely to think you need to.
When things go right.
When the prayer gets answered.
When the promotion comes.
When the business grows.
When people notice.
When somebody says, “You crushed it.”
There is a battle after the battle.
A test after the breakthrough.
Not because the blessing is bad.
But because the branch can forget the Vine.
In scarcity: Will I trust God?
In abundance: Will I remember God?
In obscurity: Will I remain faithful?
In visibility: Will I remain humble?
In weakness: Will I depend on Him?
In strength: Will I still depend on Him?

blocks.text: Sometimes the breakthrough is the entrance into a different battlefield.

items: Israel had known dependence: Egypt, the Red Sea, the wilderness, hunger, thirst.
Then God warns them about something different.
Not suffering.
Prosperity.
The danger wasn’t the blessing.
The danger was what Israel might eventually say about it:
“My power and the strength of my hands have produced this.”
There it is.
A thought.
And that thought needed capturing.
The danger isn’t becoming capable. The danger is confusing your capacity with your Source.
Some thoughts need capturing because they make you feel terrible. Others because they make you feel too important.
Blessings need discipleship too.
Don’t only return when you need something from God. Return when you have everything you asked Him for.
Jesus,
I don’t merely want Your blessings.
I want You.
Keep me near the Vine.
Amen.
